label: KT route frame entails the T schema of the route's NECESSARY_2 box
description: If the route's modal frame is reflexive (KT), the T schema of the route's box is valid on it. Applies the existing modal-library theorem TruthCore.Modal.axiomT_valid to the route frame. Establishes neither premise. No transcription is declared: the proof applies a proved library theorem with real content, not an open bridge, as in frameS5ToS4.
